LivePipeline.purpose: Coordinates the standard streaming tick workflow.

SignalEngine.purpose: Retrieves active market regime to check signal conditions.

MLGatekeeper.purpose: Applies a quality filter model offline and scores entries.

RiskGateway.purpose: Checks daily drawdowns, streak lockouts, spread/slippage thresholds.

OrderRouter.purpose: Packages transaction params and transmits allowed entries to MT5.

MT5Adapter.purpose: Executes orders on broker terminal or local mock fallback.

forbidden_bypass_rules.description: Directly execution of trades from the Signal Engine to the Order Router. Bypassing RiskGateway and ML Gatekeeper is strictly forbidden. Violation will cause immediate shutdown.
Sending trade setups directly to RiskGateway without filtering through ML Gatekeeper. Sizing adjustments and bad setup blocks must be done first.
Direct terminal adapter execution. Completely bypasses order routing, risk, and audit checks. Highly critical safety violation.
